Support preparation of Technical Comparison Tables (TCT) and technical clarification questions. Participate in technical discussions with suppliers together with senior engineers, project teams, or buyers. Perform post‑Purchase Order (PO) mechanical engineering activities, including review and checking of vendor drawings, datasheets, calculations, and specifications for compliance with contract requirements and approved design basis. Prepare review comments and support vendor document approval under supervision of the Mechanical Design Lead Cost & Proposal Support Provide mechanical inputs for quantity take‑off and cost estimation activities. Support proposal teams by preparing technical clarifications, equipment datasheets, and design assumptions. Multidisciplinary Coordination Coordinate with civil, electrical, instrumentation, automation, and process engineers to ensure design consistency. Standards & Design Compliance Apply applicable Philippine codes and regulations relevant to mechanical systems.
